data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 48.3m (2013: GBP 15.0m) is an improvement of GBP 9.4m to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to the favourable settlement of specific Consumer Products claims on 2010 & prior years of account and favourable run-off of Property reserves on all years of account.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Significant catastrophe losses arising from earthquakes in Chile contributed to poor performance and reserve strengthening on the 2010 year of account.
Significant catastrophe losses arising from earthquakes in New Zealand contributed to poor performance and reserve strengthening on the 2010 year of account.
Exposure to the Japanese earthquake contributed to the ultimate loss for the 2011 year of account.
Thailand floods were cited as a driver of poor performance on the 2011 year of account.
Hurricane Irene was mentioned as part of the adverse Property experience on the 2011 year of account.
US tornadoes were cited as contributing to poor performance on the 2011 year of account.
Claims related to Superstorm Sandy were noted as an exception to otherwise benign claims experience in 2012 and impacted the 2012 year of account.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2014 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at the start of the year (comparative 2013) were GBP 70.746m. During 2014 there was an overall improvement in prior-year reserves equivalent to approximately GBP 9.4m (net), driven principally by favourable settlements on Consumer Products claims (notably 2010 & prior years) and favourable run-off in the Property account. The report describes this as an improvement included within net claims incurred, and explicitly attributes it to specific Consumer Products settlements and Property reserve run-off; no gross prior-year movement figure is disclosed, so the quantified GBP 9.4m is reported net of reinsurance in the accounts.
raw_causal_phrases: included within net claims incurred of GBP 48.3m (2013: GBP 15.0m) is an improvement of GBP 9.4m to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to the favourable settlement of specific Consumer Products claims on 2010 & prior years of account and favourable run-off of Property reserves on all years of account
Significant Catastrophe losses arising from earthquakes in Chile and New Zealand were incurred
With the exception of claims related to Superstorm Sandy the year had initially seen benign claims experience across all lines

There has been a disappointing increase in the claims ratio of 22.4% compared to the previous year driven by an increase in attritional losses on a number of schemes and the impact of the current political and economic environment on the Political Risks book

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure explicitly stated in the report is an improvement of GBP 9.4m but is described as 'included within net claims incurred' (i.e. NET of reinsurance). No explicit gross (insurance liabilities) prior-year movement figure for claims outstanding is given in the notes; the technical reserves reconciliation shows overall gross claims outstanding movement but that line includes current-year activity and so is not a reliable prior-year movement per the extraction rules. LOB mapping for 'Consumer Products' is ambiguous (comprises Warranty, Creditor and Accident & Health) so LOB-specific amounts for the PYD are not quantified in the report.
